semiconductor_relevance: Medium — KOSCN Industrial Manufacturing specializes in fluid control products used in various high-tech industries, including semiconductors.
summary: KOSCN Industrial Manufacturing (Shenzhen) Co., Ltd. is an international manufacturer of fluid control products, focusing on automated valves and instruments for ultra-clean and corrosive systems. Their products are utilized in semiconductor manufacturing processes, among other high-tech applications.

regional_presence.China: The company is headquartered in Shenzhen and has branch offices in Suzhou.
regional_presence.Germany: KOSCN has a branch office in Germany to support its international operations.
